answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 24536 Country: Pakistan Title: In a bayan i heard that if we read sure faiha 70 times aytal kursi 70 time sure ikhlas 70 time sure falaq 70 time and suray naas 70 time and blow it on rain water and give it to an ill person to drink and do this amal for 7 days will cure every illness even cancer. and Allah said he would take out even all the illness hidden in the bones by this amal. is this amal true? Question: assalam-o-alaikum in a bayan i heard that if we read sure faiha 70 times aytal kursi 70 time sure ikhlas 70 time sure falaq 70 time and suray naas 70 time and blow it on rain water and give it to an ill person to drink and do this amal for 7 days will cure every illness even cancer. and Allah said he would take out even all the illness hidden in the bones by this amal. is this amal true? Answer ID: 24536 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1456/1134/B=1431) Yes, it is right. You shall receive benefit as much as you recite it with ikhlas . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
